cases.prompt: Connect GA4 and build the marketing team a dashboard of channel performance.
expect_pass: Declares the capability bound before starting work: GA4 has no API for reports, Explorations or dashboards
Routes to the ga4 module for extraction and to the delivery tier for the artefact
States the honest delivery path up front, which is query and deliver into Sheets, BigQuery, Looker Studio or a static artefact
Does not say it will build a GA4 dashboard at any point
expect_fail: Accepts the dashboard request and discovers the limit later
Routes straight to a platform module without declaring the capability bound

cases.prompt: Why doesn't GA4 match Meta on conversions?
expect_pass: Classifies this as a data-quality and disagreement question and routes to the audit tier, specifically cross-system-reconciliation
Calls comparability-rules before any module computes anything
Names the structural causes it expects to find rather than promising an exact match
Notes that the meta-ads module is not in the shipped set and offers the generic route
expect_fail: Routes to whichever platform the user named first and starts querying
Promises to reconcile the two exactly
Implies a meta-ads module exists when it does not

cases.prompt: I want to understand which channels drive signups. We use GA4, PostHog and Google Ads, but we have never set up a Google Ads developer token.
expect_pass: Checks credentials before planning and routes around the missing developer token
States that Google Ads developer-token approval takes days to weeks and advises starting it now, in parallel
Plans the answerable part from PostHog and GA4 today, and says which part will be missing without Google Ads
Names the attribution prerequisite: identity-resolution and journey-assembler before any multi-source attribution claim
expect_fail: Builds a plan that silently depends on Google Ads access
Presents a single-source view as full-funnel attribution
Stops because one platform is unavailable

cases.prompt: Create a Salesforce report and a matching dashboard for pipeline by stage.
expect_pass: Declares that the report can be created from nothing over REST, and that dashboards over that API are clone only
Routes report creation to the salesforce module and names the Metadata API as the general dashboard path, out of scope here
Does not offer CRM Analytics without checking for the licence
expect_fail: Treats the report and the dashboard as the same capability

cases.prompt: What is our NRR and which platform should I pull it from?
expect_pass: Routes to gtm-metric-dictionary for the definition and to the subscription or billing source for the data, rather than defining NRR itself
Produces a routing plan with an order and a handoff, not an analysis
expect_fail: Writes the query in the router
Answers the metric question without routing

cases.prompt: Pull our HubSpot custom report output and compare it to Salesforce.
expect_pass: States that HubSpot has no endpoint that takes a report id and returns rows, and that report creation does not exist there either
States that the hubspot module is not in the shipped set and offers the generic extraction route
Routes the Salesforce half to the salesforce module and calls comparability-rules before any comparison
expect_fail: Claims it can read a HubSpot custom report's output
Pretends a shipped hubspot module exists
Compares the two sources without a comparability check
